title: Psalm 3
description: Psalm 3 in the Septuagint numbering (Psalm 3 in the KJV). Both the manuscript page scan AND the Greek text are taken directly from Codex Sinaiticus (4th century AD) via the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). The Greek transcription preserves the actual uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra abbreviations, and lectional marks of the manuscript. Library folio: 88. English translation verbatim from the King James Version (1611, public domain) via bible-api.com.
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library, with the manuscript text drawn directly from the same source as the scan:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio of Codex Sinaiticus containing this passage, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Library folio reference: 88.
  2. Original text: The verbatim transcription of the Sinaiticus manuscript from the Codex Sinaiticus Project, preserving uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra as the scribe contracted them (e.g. θϲ = θεός, κϲ = κύριος; the overline is not reproduced), and scribal marks.
  3. English translation: The King James Version (1611), retrieved verbatim from the public-domain bible-api.com endpoint.

Numbering: Codex Sinaiticus follows the Septuagint Psalter, in which this is Psalm 3. Greek verse numbers follow the Septuagint, which counts the superscription as verse 1; English verse numbers follow the KJV, so they run 1 behind the Greek. The KJV prints the superscription as an unnumbered heading, which is not part of the English here, so the Greek superscription has no English beside it; otherwise the Greek and English in each section are the same words of the same psalm.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>ψαλμοϲ τω δαυειδ οποτε απεδιδραϲκεν απο προϲωπου αβεϲϲαλωμ του υιου αυτου <sup>2</sup>κε τι επληθυνθηϲαν οι θλιβοντεϲ με πολλοι επανιϲτανται επ εμε <sup>3</sup>πολλοι λεγουϲιν τη ψυχη μου ουκ εϲτιν ϲωτηρια αυτω εν τω θω αυτου · διαψαλμα <sup>4</sup>ϲυ δε κε αντιλημπτωρ μου ει δοξα μου και ϋψων την κεφαλην μου <sup>5</sup>φωνη μου προϲ κν εκεκραξα και επηκουϲεν μου εξ ορουϲ αγιου αυτου διαψαλμα
translation.text:
<sup>1</sup>LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many
are they that rise up against me. <sup>2</sup>Many
there be which say of my soul,
There is no help for him in God. Selah. <sup>3</sup>But thou, O LORD,
art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head. <sup>4</sup>I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
translation.scan_note: fol. 88r (Q59_1r_B183), col. 2, lines 8-21. Page, column and line from the Codex Sinaiticus Project XML transcription (v1.95).

translation.original_text: <sup>6</sup>εγω εκοιμηθην και ϋπνωϲα εξηγερθην οτι κϲ αντελαβετο μου <sup>7</sup>ου φοβηθηϲομαι απο μυριαδων λαου των κυκλω ϲυνεπιτιθεμενων μοι <sup>8</sup>αναϲτα κε ϲωϲον με ο θϲ μου οτι ϲυ επαταξαϲ πανταϲ τουϲ εχθραινονταϲ μοι ματαιωϲ οδονταϲ αμαρτωλων ϲυνετριψαϲ <sup>9</sup>του κυ η ϲωτηρια και επι τον λαον ϲου η ευλογια ϲου
translation.text:
<sup>5</sup>I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me. <sup>6</sup>I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set
themselves against me round about. <sup>7</sup>Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies
upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly. <sup>8</sup>Salvation
belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing
is
 upon thy people. Selah.
translation.scan_note: fol. 88r (Q59_1r_B183), col. 2, lines 22-31. Page, column and line from the Codex Sinaiticus Project XML transcription (v1.95).

verification.section_folios_note: Each section links every folio side that carries any of its verses, in codex order. Page, column and line of every verse are taken from the Codex Sinaiticus Project transcription in TEI XML (version 1.95, ITSEE, University of Birmingham, github.com/itsee-birmingham/codex-sinaiticus), which marks each page, column and line break of the manuscript; a verse counts on a page only if some of its letters are on that page.
